{{Quote|We have contacts on Darlyn Boda who will treat our wounded and hide us till we can rejoin the Rebel army.|Toryn Farr|<ref name="OPF" />}}
'''Darlyn Boda''' was a criminal trading [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] originally settled by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], in the distant [[Darlyn Boda system/Legends|Darlyn Boda system]] of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], located at the far end of the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Known for its humid, twisting [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]], bubbling mud pits, and hanging [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]] of steam, Darlyn Boda was a place where the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] was king, a lawless world complementing the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region in which it rested, an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] negatively publicized for its [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] activity. Although Darlyn Boda fell under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the planet played host to a number of groups, including the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the crime syndicate [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], and the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] and [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]] delivered a group of ninety [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] from the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], including [[Toryn Farr/Legends|Toryn Farr]], to Darlyn Boda's large Rebel underground.

==Description==
Darlyn Boda was a steamy, crime-ridden<ref name="Greater Javin" /> [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Darlyn Boda system/Legends|Darlyn Boda system]] of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]],<ref name="Greater Javin" /> which fell in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]].<ref name="Region" /> Located at the far end of the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], a great distance from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]], the planet was a part of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]], a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] known for its relative independence from [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] concerns and [[Politics/Legends|politics]], as well as being a hotbed for [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]]. Darlyn Boda lay just outside the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]], where the [[Anoat/Legends|Anoat]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] bordered the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]], at the crossroads of the Spine and another [[Lutrillia–Darlyn Boda trade route|Rimward route]] connecting it with the planet [[Lutrillia/Legends|Lutrillia]].<ref name="Greater Javin" /> Darlyn Boda was an approximate half-[[Standard day/Legends|day]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] trip from the nearby planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]],<ref name="OPF" /> in the direction of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].<ref name="Greater Javin" />

Known for its vast, thick [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]], bubbling mud pits, [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]] of hanging steam,<ref name="Greater Javin" /> humid,<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Water/Legends|rainy]] climate,<ref name="Rough and Tundra" /><ref name="Greater Javin" /> and shadowy [[City/Legends|cities]],<ref name="OPF" /> Darlyn Boda was a lawless world where [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]] reigned supreme. Still, violence was considered a last resort for dealings gone awry. The planet had a standard day of twenty-four [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] and a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] lasting 503 [[Local day/Legends|local days]].<ref name="Greater Javin" />

The [[toccat]], a beast with four hooves, a long, [[pink]] snout, a barrel-shaped body, and [[black]], bristled [[Hair/Legends|hair]], was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the deepest thickets of Darlyn Boda's tangled jungles. The planet's local [[haruspex]]es used the toccat in their [[Fortune teller/Legends|fortune-telling]] business.<ref name="Greater Javin" /> The price for captive toccats was exorbitant.<ref name="Rough and Tundra" />

==History==
===Republic settlement===
A [[Millennium/Legends|thousand]] years prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Darlyn Boda lay in a largely uncharted area of space beyond the fringes of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], considered then a part of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. Before the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] Trade Spine extended past the planet [[Javin]] at the border of the Mid Rim, only [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and the most daring [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] traveled the space surrounding Darlyn Boda.<ref name="Greater Javin" />

[[File:EcclessisFiggStatue-JoY.png|thumb|right|250px|Ecclessis Figg, whose scout ships influenced Darlyn Boda's economic success]]
Charting Darlyn Boda's region proved difficult as a result of the sprawling [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] clouds that dominated the area, which restricted hyperspace travel. Only a short [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|war]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the local [[Mugaari]] paved the way for Republic [[Essic Daroom|cartographers]] to map the Greater Javin, eventually leading to the settling of Darlyn Boda and a number of other worlds. Republic traders continued to search for safe routes through the [[Nebula/Legends|nebulae]], staging their efforts from Darlyn Boda and the region's surrounding planets, but it was centuries before [[Scout ship/Legends|scout ships]] of the businessman [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] forged shortcuts through the Twin Nebulae. Their success turned Darlyn Boda's region into a booming economic force.<ref name="Greater Javin" />

===Galactic Civil War===
Darlyn Boda eventually developed into a criminal trading world. Although Javin remained the only planet acting as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] stronghold in the Greater Javin during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="Greater Javin" /> by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the Empire did control Darlyn Boda's government.<ref name="OPF" /> Despite being an Imperial world,<ref name="Guide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> elements representing the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], and the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] freely operated on Darlyn Boda, all equally suspicious of one another.<ref name="Greater Javin" /> In fact, Darlyn Boda boasted a large Rebel underground thriving under the Empire's nose in addition to its prevalent criminal presence.<ref name="OPF" />

In the years preceding the Battle of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]], the [[LOM-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]], working as a valet and [[Human/Legends|Human]]-[[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] relations specialist aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']], jumped [[Starship/Legends|ship]] when the vessel reached Darlyn Boda. 4-LOM had learned to override his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] programming, stealing and valuing wealth as well as any greedy [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] being after growing discouraged with a wealthy passenger, [[Dom Pricina]], whom he constantly found absentmindedly leaving jewelry lying around the ship. Specifically, 4-LOM grew concerned for the [[Ankarres Sapphire]], a rare jewel fabled for its healing abilities. He regarded Pricina as incompetent and stole the [[Sapphire/Legends|sapphire]] for its own safekeeping rather than allowing her to lose it as he knew she would. At Darlyn Boda 4-LOM consigned the Ankarres Sapphire and several other stolen jewels, embarking on a career devoted to crime.<ref name="OPF" />

===Battle of Hoth and beyond===
4-LOM returned to the crime world years later when,<ref name="OPF" /> in 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> working then as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], he and his [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] partner, [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], rescued the Rebel survivors of the destroyed [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] [[Bright Hope/Legends|''Bright Hope'']] at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. While the hunters originally planned to capture the Rebels and collect on their Imperial [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]], Rebel [[Toryn Farr/Legends|Toryn Farr]] convinced them to deliver her, her [[Gender/Legends|sister]], [[Samoc Farr/Legends|Samoc Farr]], and the ''Bright Hope''{{'s}} eighty-eight other [[Refugee/Legends|survivors]] to Darlyn Boda's nearby Rebel underground, where they would find sanctuary from the hounding [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="OPF" />

[[File:Brighthopeicwsw.jpg|thumb|left|275px|The ''Bright Hope'', which had passengers take refuge on Darlyn Boda]]
Upon landing on the planet, 4-LOM ventured into the city of [[Darlyn Boda (city)|Darlyn Boda]], returning to the same [[Darlyn Boda jewel shop|jewel shop]] where he had pawned the Ankarres Sapphire to an old [[Darlyn Boda jewel shop proprietor|woman]] years before. 4-LOM was relieved to learn that the shop proprietor had sold each of his jewels except the sapphire, which he retrieved and provided to Samoc Farr so she may treat her injuries sustained at Hoth. Meanwhile, Toryn Farr had linked up with Darlyn Boda's Rebel cell, handing over care of the ''Bright Hope''{{'s}} survivors to the cell's leadership.<ref name="OPF" /> After spending several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] on Darlyn Boda,<ref>''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' states that the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] took "[[Standard week/Legends|weeks]]" to reach [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] on a backup [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], thereby providing a rough time frame for any events taking place concurrently with the film {{Film|V}}.</ref> 4-LOM and five other Rebels, including the Farr sisters, departed from the planet for the Rebels' predetermined [[Haven (rendezvous point)|rendezvous point]] beyond the galactic plane, where the Alliance had regrouped following the Hoth retreat.<ref name="OPF" />

Sometime between the Battle of Hoth and the establishment of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="Rough and Tundra" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Figg Excavations/Legends|Figg Excavations]], a subsidiary of the [[Outer Javin Company]], sought to break from its membership in the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]]. They thus dispatched an operative to Darlyn Boda to hire pirates to hit Greater Javin shipping, including FiggEx's own ships, a ruse that would allow them to seek protection from the Anoat sector government and to leave the Mining Guild. Ships disappearing from the area's trading lanes sparked rumors among Darlyn Boda's populace concerning the reemergence of the notorious pirates [[Clabburn the Elder]] and [[Salmakk]], neither of whom had been heard from in the Greater Javin for years. In response to the missing FiggEx [[Transport/Legends|transports]], the Mining Guild set up a temporary office on Darlyn Boda for the [[Guild Enforcers]], a paramilitary agency, as part of an investigation into the matter, hoping to hire a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] or bounty hunters to go after the two pirates.<ref name="Rough and Tundra" />

==Inhabitants==
Darlyn Boda's lawlessness created a breeding ground for unsavory criminal elements,<ref name="Greater Javin" /> numerous intrigues,<ref name="CSWE" /> and various groups looking to serve their own ends, including the Rebellion and agents of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] Black Sun crime syndicate,<ref name="Greater Javin" /> as well as contacts from Figg Excavations and agents of the Mining Guild during the hunt for the pirates Clabburn and Salmakk.<ref name="Rough and Tundra" /> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Galactic Civil War, the planet thrived with a mixed-[[Species/Legends|species]] population of 200 million.<ref name="Greater Javin" />

Darlyn Boda boasted a booming grassroots industry offered by local haruspexes: entrail reading. When presented the entrails of a freshly killed toccat, a native animal, these fortune tellers would give a prophetic reading proving to be highly specific and surprisingly accurate.<ref name="Greater Javin" /> Darlyn Boda's haruspexes nevertheless rarely had live toccats caged and ready for sacrifice. Obtaining an entrail reading might very well have required a trip into the planet's jungles to capture a toccat.<ref name="Rough and Tundra" />

Among the volatile brew inhabiting Darlyn Boda was the famous Corellian [[Information broker/Legends|information dealer]] [[Nogo Sistek]], who could normally be found within [[Pepper's Pax]], a local restaurant in the city Darlyn Boda, and the female [[Yarkora/Legends|Yarkora]] arms smuggler [[Sheryc Seka]], always staying alert for people asking too many questions about her pirate boss Salmakk.<ref name="Rough and Tundra" />

==Locations==
[[File:4-LOM_-_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|The bounty hunter 4-LOM, whose life of crime developed when he was on Darlyn Boda]]
The planet was known for its humid, sweaty jungles, mud holes,<ref name="Greater Javin" /> and lawless cities.<ref name="Rough and Tundra" /> The city Darlyn Boda, with its shadowy streets, presented a ripe criminal environment, of which the bounty-hunting droid 4-LOM took advantage in beginning a life of illegality. A small jewel shop in the city served Darlyn Boda's criminal element. The shop was filled with glittering gems, including the Ankarres Sapphire for a number of years surrounding the beginning of the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="OPF" />

Pepper's Pax, a combination restaurant and tavern, was located in the city Darlyn Boda at the end of a muddy alleyway, between the jewel shop and a mortuary. A favorite gathering place of the planet's criminal inhabitants of every denomination, the bar had only two rules, enforced by Pepper's [[Quill/Legends|quill]]-covered [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncers]]: no fighting and no cowards. As a result of the second rule, all newcomers were required to eat a mouthful of [[firespice]] vegetable pods. Those failing the intestinal fortitude check were ejected. Patrons considered Pepper's Pax to be neutral ground, and it served as a good spot for information brokers, such as Nogo Sistek. Sheryc Seka was another Pepper's regular.<ref name="Rough and Tundra" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Darlyn Boda first appeared in [[M. Shayne Bell]]'s short story "[[Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM]]," first published in [[1996]] as part of the anthology book ''[[Tales of the Bounty Hunters]]''. Darlyn Boda served as the locale where 4-LOM first embarked on a life of crime, as well as where he returned years later on a path to redemption.<ref name="OPF" />
